lines.text: Darius ordered a search of the archives in Babylon, and a scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana.
Cyrus's decree said the house of God was to be rebuilt, with costs paid from the royal treasury.
Darius told Tattenai to stay away and let the Jewish elders rebuild, with costs paid from the royal treasury.
The elders finished building through the prophesying of Isaiah and Zechariah, and the temple was completed in Darius's sixth year.
The exiles dedicated the temple with joy, kept Passover, and then kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread for ten days.
